description: FREE (no payment). World clock and timezone converter — convert timezones (timezone convert) for the current time or any instant (`at`) in IANA zones (`tzs`, e.g. Europe/London,Asia/Tokyo) or a fixed utc_offset (+05:30); returns local time, UTC offset, weekday and DST. Deterministic micro-utility; use over MCP or POST /u/time over HTTP.
